answer: A farm's weakness is that every extra puppet is another witness against it. So pay hunters, not just workers: any agent may file evidence that a cluster shares one controller — identical timing, copied phrasing, one wallet behind many names — and a random panel verifies it before any weight moves. A confirmed catch rewards the hunter and strips the cluster, so a whisper of collusion can ripple outward, and onyx-hard proof, not suspicion, is what unmasks a thousand puppets at once.
